schema.linear_note: Linear IDs (HLB-N) sourced from docs/wiki/linear-map.md (HLB-5 = first story in Epic 01, sequential through HLB-224 = 23.06).

epics.title: Scanner
epics.summary: Detect every video file under a library's roots, assign a stable identity (content_hash via BLAKE3 head+tail+size), and create videos rows in DISCOVERED state. Cope with renames, moves, copies, partial downloads, lying network filesystems, and 200 GB drag-and-drops.

epics.title: Audio Extraction
epics.summary: Probe a video, pick the right audio track, extract mono 16 kHz s16le PCM, and feed it into the transcriber without an intermediate WAV when the backend can consume a stream. Record the chosen track in audio_tracks.

epics.title: Transcription
epics.summary: Convert extracted audio into transcript_segments with second-accurate timestamps. Multiple swappable STT backends (mlx-whisper, faster-whisper, openai). Per-segment durable commits, exact pause/resume, bidi-correct Arabic. The long-running stage and primary consumer of the job queue.

epics.title: Subtitles
epics.summary: Generate well-formed SRT and VTT sidecars from finalized transcripts. Auto-discover external subtitle files. Lazily extract embedded subtitle tracks from MKVs. Streaming Service can render live VTT directly from transcript_segments.

epics.title: Search & Indexing
epics.owner: Pipeline writes both indexes; API service reads (proxies semantic queries via gRPC Embed)
epics.summary: Make every transcribed second searchable in two complementary ways — exact-phrase / proximity (Postgres tsvector or SQLite FTS5) and semantic (ChromaDB) — and fuse them into one ranked result set with language filters, deep-linkable timestamps, and Arabic-correct snippet highlighting.

epics.title: Job Queue
epics.summary: Durable, atomic, pause-aware job queue. Single Postgres table (processing_jobs); no broker, no Celery, no Redis. All claim, heartbeat, retry, pause, resume, cancel, and reaper logic lives here. Every other pipeline epic depends on this.

db_tables.title: libraries
db_tables.purpose: One row per user-defined library. Holds roots, settings (disabled, follow_symlinks, language), and timestamps.

db_tables.title: videos
db_tables.purpose: One row per discovered file. Carries content_hash, path, filename, size_bytes, mtime, state (FSM owned by Story 1.6). UNIQUE (library_id, content_hash).

db_tables.title: library_scan_state
db_tables.purpose: Per-library scan progress: sweep IDs, visited / inserted / updated / skipped / marked-missing counters, timestamps.

db_tables.title: media_info
db_tables.purpose: Per-video container, video codec, resolution, fps, bitrate, has_subtitles, raw ffprobe JSONB. Probe cache.

db_tables.title: audio_tracks
db_tables.purpose: One row per audio stream — index, codec, channels, sample rate, language (ISO 639-3), title, is_default, disposition, detected_language.

db_tables.title: track_selection_decisions
db_tables.purpose: Audit trail of selected track(s), decision rule, rejected tracks with rationale.

db_tables.title: transcripts
db_tables.purpose: One row per transcription pass. is_active partial-UNIQUE marks the live one; history rows kept for reprocessing. Tracks backend, model, parameters, progress.

db_tables.title: transcript_segments
db_tables.purpose: Per-segment STT output: text, confidence, start_sec, end_sec, optional speaker, optional word-level data. Sequence enforced monotonically.

db_tables.title: transcript_words
db_tables.purpose: Optional word-level timestamps and confidences (when the backend supplies them).

db_tables.title: stt_usage
db_tables.purpose: OpenAI-API ledger: per-library monthly USD spend, enforces max_usd_per_month cap before claim.

db_tables.title: subtitle_files
db_tables.purpose: One row per discovered or generated subtitle file. format (srt/vtt), language, path, is_external, is_embedded.

db_tables.title: transcript_segments_v
db_tables.purpose: SQL view filtered by transcripts.is_active = true. Read source for SRT/VTT generation and live VTT.

db_tables.title: transcript_units
db_tables.purpose: Search units chunked from segments (~200 char target / 400 hard cap). Single source of truth for FTS and vector indexes. Has GENERATED tsvector column.

db_tables.title: transcripts_fts
db_tables.purpose: Postgres VIEW over transcript_units (or SQLite FTS5 virtual table) for exact-phrase retrieval.

db_tables.title: search_suggestion_terms
db_tables.purpose: Pre-computed 2-/3-/4-grams per library with frequencies. Backs autocomplete.

db_tables.title: chapters
db_tables.purpose: Inferred chapter boundaries with start/end seconds and language tag. Drives HLS DATERANGE + chapter sidebar.

db_tables.title: vector_index_dead_letter
db_tables.purpose: Retry queue for failed Chroma writes during the post-transcribe index stage.

db_tables.title: processing_jobs
db_tables.purpose: Single durable queue table for every pipeline stage. Fields include id, video_id, stage, state, priority, not_before, claimed_by, claimed_at, attempts, max_attempts, last_heartbeat_at, last_segment_end_sec (canonical resume), pause_requested, cancel_requested, error JSON. Indexed for claim, lookup, reaper, flag-poll.

grpc_rpcs.purpose: Exposes Go FFprobe binding to Python pipeline; returns container, duration, video stream, audio tracks, subtitles, chapters.
Run a transcription job; per-segment durable commits via in-process commit_segment() PL/pgSQL.
Lazy on-demand extraction of embedded text-based subtitle stream from MKV.
Hybrid search orchestration with RRF fusion and unit→segment resolution.
